title: Dynamic Compression

metrics.settling_definition: time to enter and remain within ±3 dB of the steady-state output level
metrics.dynamic_note: The configured attack/release values are one-pole detector time constants applied to signal power; the observed output-level settling time is not numerically identical to them, especially for release.
metrics.note: All values are measured through the virtual device; configured ground truth is reported alongside the estimates.

narrative: The virtual compressor follows the configured static curve closely; the effective compression ratio recovered above the kneepoint is close to the configured ratio, and attack/release times are in the expected millisecond range. The multiband test shows that a loud high-frequency tone can be compressed independently of the low-frequency band, which is the behaviour needed for realistic hearing-aid fitting scenarios and for validating the gain-estimation experiments.
